bracket_note: Most buyer interest arrives in the first two to three weeks of a campaign. Buyers searching portals filter by price, and a guide above $2.75m hides your home from buyers whose search tops out there. Most buyers for a 4-bed home in this pocket are working in the $2.5m to $2.8m bracket.

market.meaning: Recent sales have needed a median of 50 days, against 27 days across the past year. There are 17 houses for sale, and 9 came on in the last 30 days, so buyers see fresh choice every week. Four-bedroom houses grew just 2.3% over 12 months, well behind the suburb's +8.9%, which larger homes drove. Pricing to today's market, rather than to last year's, is what gets a home sold.
market.source: Source: Stash Property (stashproperty.com.au), Bulimba house sales and listings, as at 28 Oct 2026.

campaigns.note: The pattern is consistent: a home priced in line with the market from day one sells within a month. A home that starts high usually sells for less in the end, and takes months longer.

position.growth_note: Over the past 12 months, Bulimba 4-bed houses rose just 2.3%, while 5-beds rose 13.8%. The market is rewarding size, and a 4-bed home's price has to reflect that.

options.intro: There are three ways forward, and the decision is yours. Your agent will talk you through how each option fits your timing and goals.

items.title: A · Hold the current guide
items.involves: Keep offers over $2.95m and continue the campaign.
items.outcome: On current evidence, the campaign is likely to run past 60 days, like the competing listings. Buyers start to ask why it hasn't sold, and the final price tends to come in lower.

items.title: B · Align the guide to the market
items.involves: Move the guide to offers over $2.58m, inside the range where comparable homes sell.
items.outcome: Opens the home to buyers searching up to $2.75m, re-alerts portal watchers, and gives buyers already in the market a reason to inspect again.

items.title: C · Set a date: best offers by
items.involves: Keep the guide at $2.58m–$2.79m and set a best-offers deadline 14–21 days out.
items.outcome: Creates urgency and lets buyers compete. Your reserve stays protected: no offer has to be accepted.
